dead-entry.label: A forgotten object entry sits below the live gold
dead-entry.explanation: A level-12 Warrior stands at (3,3) near the top-left corner of a lit open room, with a pile of gold four grids east. An earlier object was recorded and forgotten with the production delete, so entry 1 of the object list is zeroed (kind 0, location 0,0) and the gold is entry 2. The production Lunal take routine decides which way to go. Original: the dead entry is not skipped, the corner grid (0,0), which is in view, becomes a target next to the gold and is nearer, so the Borg steps north-west towards the corner (goal 2,2). Corrected: the dead entry is skipped and the Borg steps east towards the gold (goal 4,3).
